biomarkers.name: BRAF V600E
biomarkers.clinical_use: Dabrafenib + trametinib is an FDA-approved standard systemic option for BRAF V600E-mutant ATC and is practice-changing in this subset

biomarkers.name: TERT promoter mutations
biomarkers.clinical_use: Very common; associated with aggressive biology and adverse prognosis

biomarkers.name: NRAS
biomarkers.clinical_use: Recurrent alternative driver, usually within the broader RAS-mutant subset rather than a standalone diagnostic marker

biomarkers.name: PD-L1
biomarkers.clinical_use: Immune checkpoint inhibitors are under investigation and used in selected combination or salvage settings; PD-L1 is not an established standard companion biomarker in ATC

biomarkers.name: RAS (HRAS/NRAS/KRAS)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Common driver class alternative to BRAF; helps define molecular subset

biomarkers.name: RET/NTRK/ALK fusions
biomarkers.clinical_use: Important to test because rare actionable fusions can enable matched targeted therapy

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Undifferentiated; spindle cell, giant cell, or squamoid morphology; extensive necrosis; high mitotic index
histomorphological_subtype.grading: By definition high-grade / undifferentiated; T4a intrathyroidal, T4b extrathyroidal

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Often highly inflamed / immune infiltrated; PD-L1 elevated
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Extensive necrosis; neutrophilic and macrophage infiltrate common

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Thyroid follicular epithelial cells with complete dedifferentiation
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Endoderm — pharyngeal pouch derivative (though lineage is often unrecognisable morphologically)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Undifferentiated by definition — no follicular architecture, no thyroglobulin production, no iodine avidity
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Represents endpoint of thyroid dedifferentiation cascade; sarcomatoid transformation with EMT features common; occasional focal transitional areas identify differentiated precursor
